value: When the Scourge reached Quel’Thalas, Thalorien held the approach before the Sunwell. He fell in that defense, buying time for those behind him; the quest’s memory binds his name to the blade he carried. The golden island was not spared its wound, and the champion was not carried into the future. His stand belongs to the Third War, long before this Wrath quest asks another hand to restore his sword.
editorNote: Original paraphrase for research status. Check quest sequence, faction branch and setting against the original 3.3.5a client before lore approval. Randomized gameplay or mutually exclusive branches do not assert a unique canonical adventurer.
